english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being qualified or allowed to take part in something.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when someone meets the standard or has enough training for a job.

examples.english: You are eligible to represent the school in the competition.
examples.traditional: 你夠資格代表學校出賽。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gau3 zi1 gaak3 doi6 biu2 hok6 haau6 ceot1 coi3

examples.english: After three years, you are qualified for promotion to supervisor.
examples.traditional: 你做咗三年，夠資格升做主管喇。
examples.jyutping: nei5 zou6 zo2 saam1 nin4 gau3 zi1 gaak3 sing1 zou6 zyu2 gun2 laa3
